title: Arrow Rush
one_line: Clear every arrow off the board without a collision. 100 classic levels and 10 adventure worlds.
how_to_play: Tap an arrow to fire it; it flies until it hits a wall or another arrow. Clear the whole board to win.
description:
A calm, clever puzzle game. Every arrow points somewhere. Tap to fire it, and it slides until something stops it: a wall or another arrow. Clear the board in the right order, without a collision, and you win the level.

There are three ways to play. Classic takes you through 100 levels on a fair difficulty curve that ramps up gently, with a breather after every spike. Adventure has 10 worlds of themed mazes, and the stars you collect unlock the next world. Daily gives you a fresh board every day: keep your streak going, and if you miss a day you can replay it free, no rush. Clear all of a month's daily boards and you win that month's trophy.

It is for anyone who likes a quiet puzzle, for a quick break or a long evening of levels. It runs in your browser on a phone or a computer, and your progress is saved, so you can pick up right where you left off. Arrow Rush is also on Google Play and the App Store.
controls: Tap an arrow to fire it the way it points
Tap the hint button when you are stuck
Use Restart to try a level again
tips: Start with the arrows that have a clear path to the edge
Clear a level with no hints, paths or revives for the top rating
Play the daily board every day to build your streak; a missed day can be replayed free
story: I started with zero technical knowledge and learned to build games with AI. Arrow Rush is the one I kept improving, iteration after iteration, measuring every number, until more than 10,000 players had played it. It is built and grown in the Stratos Games Factory, from the first build to launch.
